images.title: Running totals grow
images.purpose: Show the running totals of 3, 6, 9, 12 as growing bars: 3, 9, 18, 30.
images.composition: Four bars on a baseline, evenly spaced, each with its total above.
images.exact_structure: Four vertical bars of equal width and equal gaps on one baseline, heights in exact ratio 1 : 3 : 6 : 10 for totals 3, 9, 18, 30. The first three bars are teal #0072B2, the last bar amber #E69F00. Each bar has its total above it. One caption centred below. Exactly 4 bars.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
bar heights not in the ratio 1 : 3 : 6 : 10
images.takeaway: Each running total adds the next number to the last total.
images.description: Four bars of heights 3, 9, 18 and 30 in proportion, the last in amber, labelled running totals.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say how much taller each bar is than the one before.

image_decisions.why: Bars show the totals piling up faster each step.
